source.title: CDC — PPE for Confirmed Patients and Clinically Unstable Patients Suspected to have VHF (Sections 9A, 9C; PAPR option)
source.note: Step titles and instructions are condensed from the CDC text. Training and decision support only; follow your facility's approved protocol.

instruction.en: The observer reads each step aloud and visually confirms all PPE is serviceable and donned correctly. No exposed clothing, skin or hair at the end.
instruction.sw: Mwangalizi asome kila hatua kwa sauti na athibitishe kwa macho kuwa PPE yote iko salama na imevaliwa ipasavyo. Mwishoni pasionekane nguo, ngozi wala nywele.

instruction.en: Change into scrubs and washable footwear. No jewelry, watches, phones, pagers or pens. Tie back long hair; secure eyeglasses with a tie.
instruction.sw: Vaa sare za upasuaji (scrubs) na viatu vinavyooshwa. Usiwe na vito, saa, simu, peja wala kalamu. Funga nywele ndefu; funga miwani kwa kamba.

instruction.en: Check the ensemble is serviceable, complete and correctly sized. Review the donning sequence together.
instruction.sw: Hakikisha vifaa viko salama, vimekamilika na vina ukubwa sahihi. Pitieni pamoja mfuatano wa kuvaa.

instruction.en: If the coverall has no integrated socks, wear the boot cover's upper band UNDER the coverall pant leg.
instruction.sw: Ikiwa ovaroli haina soksi zilizoungana, sehemu ya juu ya kifuniko cha buti iwe CHINI ya mguu wa suruali ya ovaroli.

instruction.en: Put on the first pair of gloves.
instruction.sw: Vaa jozi ya kwanza ya glavu.

instruction.en: Ensure free movement and that inner glove cuffs are tucked under the sleeves. Self-contained PAPR belt/battery goes under the gown; external blower and tubing go outside.
instruction.sw: Hakikisha unaweza kusogea kwa uhuru na pindo za glavu za ndani ziko chini ya mikono ya gauni. Mkanda/betri ya PAPR ya ndani ivaliwe chini ya gauni; blower ya nje na mrija viwe nje.

instruction.en: Put on the second pair (extended cuffs). Pull the cuffs over the gown or coverall sleeves.
instruction.sw: Vaa jozi ya pili (yenye pindo ndefu). Vuta pindo juu ya mikono ya gauni au ovaroli.

instruction.en: Put on the PAPR with full face shield, helmet or headpiece, plus a single-use hood covering all hair and ears and extending past the neck to the shoulders.
instruction.sw: Vaa PAPR yenye kinga kamili ya uso, kofia ngumu au kifaa cha kichwa, pamoja na kofia ya matumizi moja inayofunika nywele zote na masikio hadi mabegani.

instruction.en: Put on a disposable apron as an extra layer for the front of the body.
instruction.sw: Vaa aproni ya kutupwa kama tabaka la ziada mbele ya mwili.

instruction.en: Observer verifies integrity. Extend arms, bend at the waist, move through a full range of motion while staying fully covered.
instruction.sw: Mwangalizi athibitishe usalama wa vazi. Nyoosha mikono, inama kiunoni, jisogeze kikamilifu huku ukibaki umefunikwa kabisa.

instruction.en: Observer reads each step aloud and confirms removal visually. Avoid reflexive actions such as touching your face.
instruction.sw: Mwangalizi asome kila hatua kwa sauti na athibitishe kwa macho. Epuka vitendo vya ghafla kama kugusa uso wako.

instruction.en: Look for visible contamination, cuts or tears. Clean and disinfect any visible contamination with an EPA-registered disinfectant wipe.
instruction.sw: Tafuta uchafu unaoonekana, mipasuko au matundu. Safisha na kuua vijidudu kwa kitambaa cha dawa kilichosajiliwa na EPA.

instruction.en: Disinfect outer-gloved hands with a disinfectant wipe or ABHR and allow to dry.
instruction.sw: Safisha mikono yenye glavu za nje kwa kitambaa cha dawa au ABHR na acha ikauke.

instruction.en: Break or untie the neck strap and waist ties, roll the apron away from you containing the soiled surface, and discard without contaminating gloves.
instruction.sw: Kata au fungua kamba ya shingo na kiuno, kunja aproni mbali nawe ukificha upande mchafu, kisha itupe bila kuchafua glavu.

instruction.en: After removing the apron, inspect the ensemble for contamination, cuts or tears; disinfect affected areas.
instruction.sw: Baada ya kuvua aproni, kagua vazi kwa uchafu, mipasuko au matundu; safisha maeneo yaliyoathirika.

title.sw: Safisha na uvue glavu za nje

instruction.en: Disinfect outer gloves, then remove and discard them without contaminating the inner gloves.
instruction.sw: Safisha glavu za nje, kisha zivue na kuzitupa bila kuchafua glavu za ndani.

title.sw: Kagua na usafishe glavu za ndani

instruction.en: Inspect inner gloves. If soiled: disinfect, remove, hand hygiene, new gloves. If clean: disinfect. A cut or tear means review exposure risk immediately.
instruction.sw: Kagua glavu za ndani. Zikichafuka: safisha, vua, safisha mikono, vaa mpya. Zikiwa safi: safisha. Mpasuko au tundu: kagua hatari ya maambukizi mara moja.

title.sw: Vua kipumulio (blower ya mkanda wa nje)

instruction.en: Remove the headpiece (help may be needed), then the belt-mounted blower; place reusable PAPR parts in the designated container. Disinfect inner gloves. (Self-contained helmet PAPR: wait until the later respirator step.)
instruction.sw: Vua kifaa cha kichwa (huenda ukahitaji msaada), kisha blower ya mkanda; weka sehemu za PAPR zinazotumika tena kwenye chombo maalum. Safisha glavu za ndani. (PAPR ya kofia yenye blower ndani: subiri hatua ya baadaye.)

instruction.en: Untie or gently break fasteners. Pull away from the body, rolling inside out and touching only the inside. For a coverall, tilt head back, unzip fully, roll down inside out. Use a mirror.
instruction.sw: Fungua au kata vifungo taratibu. Vuta mbali na mwili, ukikunja ndani-nje na kugusa ndani pekee. Kwa ovaroli, inamisha kichwa nyuma, fungua zipu yote, kunja chini ndani-nje. Tumia kioo.

instruction.en: Disinfect inner gloves with a disinfectant wipe or ABHR.
instruction.sw: Safisha glavu za ndani kwa kitambaa cha dawa au ABHR.

instruction.en: Sitting on a new clean surface (second chair or clean side of bench), pull off boot covers without contaminating pant legs.
instruction.sw: Ukiwa umeketi mahali safi papya (kiti cha pili au upande safi wa benchi), vua vifuniko vya buti bila kuchafua suruali.

instruction.en: Wipe every external surface of the washable shoes with a disinfectant wipe.
instruction.sw: Pangusa kila upande wa nje wa viatu kwa kitambaa cha dawa.

instruction.en: Disinfect inner gloves with a disinfectant wipe or ABHR.
instruction.sw: Safisha glavu za ndani kwa kitambaa cha dawa au ABHR.

instruction.en: Self-contained helmet PAPR: remove and discard the hood, disinfect inner gloves, then remove helmet and belt/battery (help may be needed). Place reusable parts in the designated container.
instruction.sw: PAPR ya kofia: vua na utupe kofia laini, safisha glavu za ndani, kisha vua kofia ngumu na mkanda/betri (huenda ukahitaji msaada). Weka sehemu za kutumika tena kwenye chombo maalum.

title.sw: Safisha na uvue glavu za ndani

instruction.en: Disinfect inner-gloved hands, then remove and discard gloves without contaminating bare hands.
instruction.sw: Safisha mikono yenye glavu za ndani, kisha vua na utupe glavu bila kuchafua mikono mitupu.

instruction.en: Perform hand hygiene with ABHR.
instruction.sw: Safisha mikono kwa ABHR.

instruction.en: Observer and worker inspect scrubs for contamination. If found, remove garments carefully, shower immediately and inform the infection preventionist.
instruction.sw: Mwangalizi na mhudumu wakague sare kwa uchafu. Ukipatikana, vua nguo kwa uangalifu, oga mara moja na mjulishe mtaalamu wa kuzuia maambukizi.

instruction.en: Leave in washable footwear and scrubs, go directly to the shower area. Infection prevention reviews care activities and records fatigue regularly.
instruction.sw: Toka ukiwa na viatu na sare, nenda moja kwa moja bafuni. Kitengo cha kuzuia maambukizi kipitie shughuli na kurekodi uchovu mara kwa mara.
